subject: math
name: Mathematics
title: Pre-K Mathematics: Early Numeracy & Shapes
overview: Pre-K mathematics develops foundational number sense, geometric reasoning, and spatial awareness through manipulative investigations, problem-solving routines, and structured discussions.
competencies: Demonstrate deep conceptual understanding of Pre-K number systems and operations.
Identify, describe, and analyze two-dimensional and three-dimensional geometric figures.
Apply measurement tools and strategies to quantify length, weight, and volume.
Solve real-world story problems using visual models, drawings, and mathematical notation.

modules.title: Counting, Quantities & Numbers to 5
modules.description: Introduces foundational counting, number recognition, and one-to-one correspondence for numbers 1 to 5 using concrete objects, fingers, and songs.

topics.title: Matching and Sorting Objects
topics.description: Matching identical objects, sorting by attributes such as color, size, and shape.

topics.title: Counting 1, 2, and 3
topics.description: Developing one-to-one correspondence and identifying quantities up to 3.

topics.title: Counting 4 and 5
topics.description: Counting objects in linear and scattered arrays up to 5 and writing numerals.

modules.title: Shapes, Space & Position
modules.description: Explores basic two-dimensional shapes (circles, squares, triangles, rectangles) and positional spatial vocabulary.

topics.title: Two-Dimensional Shapes
topics.description: Identifying, describing, and drawing circles, squares, rectangles, and triangles.

topics.title: Positional Spatial Words
topics.description: Using prepositions such as above, below, beside, in front of, and behind.

modules.title: Comparing Quantities & Measurement
modules.description: Comparing groups of objects using more than, less than, and the same as, and measuring lengths directly.

topics.title: Comparing Sets
topics.description: Comparing groups of items up to 5 to determine greater than or fewer than.

topics.title: Direct Measurement
topics.description: Comparing lengths, weights, and capacities of real-world classroom items.
